findings.evidence: Splitting.lean:140, 191, 199 are the same term; `grep -rn "finrank_eq_one_iff_bijective_algebraMap" mathlib/Mathlib` returns only the lemma itself plus one use, and no bundled `AlgEquiv` exists in either repo.
findings.fix: Introduce one construction, e.g. `noncomputable def baseFieldAlgEquivOfFinrankEqOne (h : Module.finrank K D = 1) : D ≃ₐ[K] K` (it needs only `Field K`, `Ring D`, `Algebra K D`), and use it at all three sites: line 139 as `f.trans (AlgEquiv.mapMatrix (baseFieldAlgEquivOfFinrankEqOne K D hD))`, line 190 as `IsBrauerEquivalent.of_algEquiv K (baseFieldAlgEquivOfFinrankEqOne K D h)`, and define `baseFieldAlgEquivOfIsBrauerTrivial K D h := baseFieldAlgEquivOfFinrankEqOne K D ((isBrauerTrivial_iff_finrank_eq_one K D).1 h)` (the two `@[simp]` characterisations still hold by `rfl`).
findings.issue: The construction `(AlgEquiv.ofBijective (Algebra.ofId K D) (Algebra.finrank_eq_one_iff_bijective_algebraMap.1 h)).symm : D ≃ₐ[K] K` is written out three times: lines 140-141, 191-192 and 199-201. Mathlib has no bundled form of it (only the iff `Algebra.finrank_eq_one_iff_bijective_algebraMap`, mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Dimension/FreeAndStrongRankCondition.lean:298), and TauCeti has none either (grep for `≃ₐ[K] K` gives only `baseFieldAlgEquivOfFinite`, Wedderburn.lean:117, and `centerAlgEquivOfIsCentral`).

findings.evidence: grep TauCeti/Algebra/CentralSimple/Degree.lean:184 `deg_eq_of_algEquiv`, :242 `deg_sq`, :257 `deg_matrix`, :271 `deg_eq_mul_deg_of_algEquiv_matrix (e : A ≃ₐ[K] Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) D) : deg K A = n * deg K D`; Splitting.lean:125-138 derives the same facts from `Module.finrank_matrix` and `Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left`.
findings.fix: Replace the block by the degree computation: `deg_eq_of_algEquiv e'` with `deg_matrix` and `deg_self` gives `p * deg K A = q`; with `hsize : p * r = q` and `p ≠ 0` this gives `deg K A = r`; `deg_eq_mul_deg_of_algEquiv_matrix f : deg K A = r * deg K D` with `NeZero r` then gives `deg K D = 1`, and `deg_sq` turns that into `Module.finrank K D = 1` for the final step.
findings.issue: Lines 124-138 redo the Wedderburn dimension bookkeeping by hand (`h1`, `h2`, `h3`, `hA`, `hD`) when TauCeti's degree API already packages exactly this count: `Algebra.deg_eq_of_algEquiv` (Degree.lean:184), `Algebra.deg_matrix` (Degree.lean:257), `Algebra.deg_sq` (Degree.lean:242) and `Algebra.deg_eq_mul_deg_of_algEquiv_matrix` (Degree.lean:271), whose docstring says it is written for the presentation produced by `exists_algEquiv_matrix_centralDivisionRing` — the very `f` used here.

summary: The new mathematics is genuinely new and reuses the Wedderburn-uniqueness API correctly, but Splitting.lean clones the same `algebraMap`-bijectivity algebra equivalence three times and re-derives by hand the Wedderburn degree count that TauCeti's own `Algebra.deg` API already provides.
